description: 2024 NTD Annual Data - Facility Inventory is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. The Facility Inventory dataset details all facilities supporting public transit service as reported to the National Transit Database (NTD) by each public transit agency in the 2024 report year. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 35 columns, among them Notes, lat_long_geo_reference, street_address_geo_reference, Administrative/Maintenance Facility Flag, Passenger/Parking Facility Flag, Separate Asset Flag. The portal shows 2026-02-24 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
